query:
UPDATE persistence_schema_compatibility
        SET schema_version = ?1,
            min_reader_app_version = '0.3.3',
            min_writer_app_version = '0.3.3',
            updated_by_migration = ?1,
            updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
        WHERE singleton_key = 1
